{{Quote|The worst part about our job are these boring strategy conferences.''"<br />"''Cheer up, Anakin. This is your chance to voice all your complaints about military protocol. And it looks as though we can finally get underway. I will inform Master Windu the last straggler has arrived, while ''you'' work on your attitude.''"<br />"''Isn't that ship coming in a little too fast?|Anakin Skywalker and Obi-Wan Kenobi|<ref name="Point of No Return">{{TCW|Point of No Return (The Clone Wars)}}</ref>}}
The '''Republic strategy conference''', also referred to as the '''Republic Valor strategy conference''', was held in [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] aboard the [[Valor (space station)/Legends|''Valor'']] [[Space station/Legends|space station]]. [[Republic officer/Legends|Officers]] from the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]] and members of the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi High Council]] and [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] convened to discuss their ongoing efforts against the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. However, before at least one stage of the conference began, it was interrupted when the CIS-stolen [[Venator-class Star Destroyer/Legends|Venator-class Star Destroyer]] ''[[Renown/Legends|Renown]]'', filled with explosive [[Rhydonium/Legends|rhydonium]], was sent out of hyperspace to ram the station, killing important attendees. However, the attempt was foiled by [[D-Squad/Legends|D-Squad]], under the command of [[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] [[Meebur Gascon/Legends|Meebur Gascon]].

==The conference==
In addition to [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Masters]] [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]] and [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] of the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi High Council]], [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] also attended the conference. Also, [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Wilhuff Tarkin/Legends|Wilhuff Tarkin]] and other [[Republic officer/Legends|officers]] of the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]] attended, as well as several [[Clone Commander/Legends|clone trooper commanders]], including [[Cody/Legends|CC-2224]], [[Neyo/Legends|CC-8826]], and [[Wolffe/Legends|CC-3636]].

At one point, members of the Republic military leadership were milling around in a strategic conference room, waiting for the ''[[Renown/Legends|Renown]]'' to join the multiple other [[Venator-class Star Destroyer/Legends|Venator-class Star Destroyers]] gathering around the station so that at least one stage of the conference could begin. Skywalker was just voicing his complaints about conferences of the type when he noted that the ''Renown''{{'s}} approach was too fast. In fact, [[D-Squad/Legends|D-Squad]], a covert military [[Droid/Legends|droid]] unit, which included Skywalker's beloved astromech [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]], was at work on board the ship to prevent the ''Renown, ''a [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]]-stolen ship laden with volatile [[Rhydonium/Legends|rhydonium]], from ramming the station and killing the conference attendees. The entirety of the unit except for R2-D2 had managed to escape the doomed ship, while he stayed behind to prevent the destruction of the ''Valor''.

Admiral Tarkin checked a console and reported the high amount of rhydonium on board. Just as Skywalker realized that it was a bomb, R2's efforts led to its premature detonation. The ensuing detonation of a ''Venator''-class' hangar space's worth of rhydonium pelted the station with debris. Though the conference room underwent substantial shaking and its glass was cracked, eventually no significant damage was dealt. D-Squad's commander, [[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] [[Meebur Gascon/Legends|Meebur Gascon]], managed to raise the station on comm. Skywalker promptly left the conference to oversee the recovery mission of R2-D2, which succeeded and resulted in his repair.
